newsitem.title: USA: Chilean president to address U.S. Congress.
newsitem.headline: Chilean president to address U.S. Congress.

text.p: Chilean President Eduardo Frei will address a joint meeting of the U.S. Congress on Feb. 27, House Speaker Newt Gingrich announced on Tuesday.

"We are very pleased that President Frei will address a joint meeting of Congress, an event that highlights our recognition of the important relationship between the United States and our neighbours in this hemisphere," Gingrich, a Georgia Republian, said in a statement.

Gingrich said he expected the Clinton administration to soon request expedited trade-negotiating authority with Chile and added, "we look forward to working with the president in support of this opportunity to expand free trade with Chile."
Frei's speech will come during a two-day state visit to Washington.
